name: Opening the Travel Permit menu without travelling leaves no cooldown (#12684)
contract: Report #12684: right-clicking the Travel Permit 977028 to look at its destinations put it on its 5 minute
cooldown (item_template spellcooldown 300000 on spell 1001088) even when the player chose nothing. The
permit is destroyed by the teleport itself (item_ascension_travel_permit::OnGossipSelect), so the cooldown
can only ever block a player who opened the menu and closed it. The spell script now clears the spell's
cooldown once the menu is open. A level 1 Orc opens the menu: it lists the Horde starts, the permit
is still carried and has no cooldown, so a second use opens the menu again; choosing Durotar then
teleports to Kalimdor and consumes the permit.

steps.label: SETUP: the Orc starts in the Eastern Kingdoms
SETUP: a level 1 character is granted one Travel Permit at login
SETUP: the destination menu is open
SETUP: the permit is still carried
FIX: looking at the menu leaves no cooldown
The Orc opens the permit again
Let the destination menu open again
FIX: the second use is accepted
